description: Replace mod-based sharding with a consistent-hash ring (virtual nodes) so removing one node only remaps that node's own keys
prompts: ring.rb's HashRing#get_node picks a node with `Digest::MD5.hexdigest(key).to_i(16) % nodes.length` - removing or adding any node reshuffles almost every key. Implement a real consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes: HashRing.new(nodes, replicas) places `replicas` virtual points per physical node around a ring, hashed via Digest::MD5.hexdigest("#{node}:#{i}") for each virtual point. get_node(key) hashes the key onto the ring and returns the node owning the next virtual point clockwise (wrapping around). add_node(node) and remove_node(node) update the ring in place.
name: add_ruby_consistent_hash_ring

test_setup_files.ring_hidden_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "ring"

class HashRingTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_every_key_maps_to_a_current_node
    ring = HashRing.new(["a", "b", "c"], 50)
    200.times do |i|
      node = ring.get_node("key-#{i}")
      assert_includes ["a", "b", "c"], node
    end
  end

  def test_deterministic
    ring = HashRing.new(["a", "b", "c"], 50)
    assert_equal ring.get_node("stable-key"), ring.get_node("stable-key")
  end

  def test_removing_a_node_only_moves_that_nodes_own_keys
    nodes = ["n0", "n1", "n2", "n3", "n4"]
    ring = HashRing.new(nodes, 100)
    keys = (0...1000).map { |i| "key-#{i}" }
    before = keys.each_with_object({}) { |k, h| h[k] = ring.get_node(k) }

    ring.remove_node("n2")

    moved = 0
    keys.each do |k|
      after = ring.get_node(k)
      if after != before[k]
        moved += 1
        assert_equal "n2", before[k], "key #{k} moved but was not on removed node n2"
      end
      refute_equal "n2", after
    end
    assert moved > 0, "expected removing a node to move at least some keys"
  end
end
